results.question: Which stores in Polk County dropped a tier between 2026 Q2 and 2026 Q3, and why?
results.answer:
In Polk County, 42 stores dropped a tier between 2026 Q2 and Q3: 20 fell from A to B (including Costco #1630 in Ankeny, H & A Mini Mart, Hy-Vee #1 WDM and World Liquor & Tobacco) and 22 fell from B to C (including several Target, Maverik and Casey's stores). The main reason is weaker sales growth. 38 of the 42 had lower Q3 sales than in Q2, for example −39% at Fareway #236 in Bondurant, −42% at Mega Saver Altoona and −29% at H & A Mini Mart, and their growth rank fell sharply, often from above 0.7 to below 0.3. The four whose sales held up or rose (Casey's #44, Maverik #5168 Guthrie, QuikTrip #559 Fleur and Fareway #183 Fleur) dropped mostly because their month-to-month sales became less steady. Fareway #183's consistency rank, for example, fell from 0.89 to 0.10.

These reasons come from comparing each store's Q2 and Q3 score ranks. The model's top_reasons column only covers predictions for next quarter, so it doesn't explain this past drop.
